summary: Added sdk/pvp/strategies.py with PvpStrategy (validated, content-hashed config_version that ignores description and evidence tier), StrategyRegistry (immutable published versions, latest lookup), ExperimentWindow and ExperimentSchedule (UTC-only half-open windows, no overlaps per alias, registered strategies only, active_strategy lookup), two candidate strategies as hypotheses, and strategy_index. Exported from sdk.pvp. 13 offline tests in tests/test_pvp_strategies.py; existing PvP safety tests still pass (no network imports, no mutation identifiers). Documented in docs/baseline/pvp-strategies.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Battle strategy was a free enum label on BattleResult with no versioned configuration or experiment assignment
contract_status_changes.after: Strategies are versioned, hashed data; experiment windows attribute any time to at most one strategy per account

residual_risks: The candidate strategies' AI rule vocabulary (conditions/actions strings) is descriptive; it is not yet mapped to the game's native AI condition/action ids.
